name: Alphabet
description: Players must speak in alphabetical order, with each line starting with the next letter of the alphabet

name: Party Host
description: One player hosts a party while others arrive with specific quirks or characteristics

name: Props
description: Players use random objects as something other than what they actually are

name: Freeze Tag
description: Two players start a scene, others tap in and create new scenes based on the frozen positions

name: Questions Only
description: Players can only communicate through questions

name: Scenes from a Hat
description: Players act out scenes based on audience suggestions written on paper

name: World's Worst
description: Players demonstrate the worst possible way to do various activities

name: Gibberish Translation
description: One player speaks gibberish while another translates the meaning

name: Conducted Story
description: A conductor controls the pace and emotion of storytellers

name: Living Props
description: Some players become inanimate objects while others use them in scenes

name: Sound Effects
description: Actors perform a scene while others provide live sound effects

name: New Choice
description: Host can call 'new choice' to make players change their last line or action
